sn38.13:1.6: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etesam bhavānam pariññāyāti || ||

sn38.13:1.8: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etesam bhavānam pariññāyāti || ||
